en.summary: This commit fixes Normalizer saved-stats handling so load and store decisions use the retiring output context instead of the current input request, and it removes an extra cycle from loaded stats.
why_it_counts: It changes the Normalizer output path that returns mean and inverse standard deviation to the rest of the DUT.
The patch switches load_stats and store_stats decisions from io.in.bits.acc_read_resp to stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp, which is the selected output context.
The loaded-stat outputs also stop passing through RegNext, eliminating a one-cycle skew on restored statistics.
evidence: Normalizer.scala changes the load_stats condition from io.in.bits.acc_read_resp.load_stats to stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp.load_stats.
The stat_mem index likewise changes to stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp.stat_addr for the load path.
The old RegNext wrappers on stat_mem_entry.mean and stat_mem_entry.inv_stddev are removed, and the store_stats condition is also tied to stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A normalization engine that can track multiple in-flight statistic contexts must use the metadata of the retiring output context when loading or storing saved statistics. If it instead consults the current ingress request, the saved-stat RAM can be read or written using the wrong context ID whenever requests overlap in time. Adding an unnecessary extra register stage on restored statistics further shifts the returned values relative to the output handshake.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: At least one stats context is retiring while a different request is entering or has already updated the current input metadata.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drive saved-stat load/store control from the current input request rather than the selected output context, and optionally add an extra cycle to restored-stat outputs.
portability_notes: Map this to any reduction or normalization block with multiple outstanding contexts and a small RAM of saved statistics or calibration state.
The key portability point is choosing the retiring context metadata, not Gemmini's specific out_stats_id name.
The extra-cycle part of the bug is secondary but useful if the target DUT also has explicit restored-stat timing.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the output-selection logic that chooses which stats context is retiring this cycle.
Change the saved-stat RAM control and index to use the newest input request metadata instead of the retiring context metadata.
Optionally insert one register stage on the restored mean or inverse-standard-deviation outputs.
Run overlapping saved-stat load and store sequences with more than one context ID.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Normalizer output selection for stat_mem load and store
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix ties load_stats, store_stats, and stat_mem addressing to stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp and removes RegNext from restored stat outputs.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp with io.in.bits.acc_read_resp in the stat_mem load and store logic, and add back RegNext on the loaded mean and inv_stddev.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Saved statistics are read from or written to the wrong context entry and can also emerge one cycle late, leading to wrong normalization parameters on later uses.
evidence_for_injection: Every functional change in the patch is about which request metadata drives the saved-stat RAM and when the restored values appear.
The new code consistently uses stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp for both load and store, showing the bug was a context-source mix-up rather than a data-format issue.
The removed RegNext indicates there was also a real timing skew on restored stats, which can be reintroduced straightforwardly.
notes: This bug is easiest to trigger with interleaved context IDs rather than a single isolated normalization stream.
If only one mutation is desired, the wrong-context selection is the primary fault and the extra cycle is optional.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 Normalizer 保存统计量的处理逻辑，使 load 和 store 使用的是正在退役的输出上下文而不是当前输入请求，同时去掉了恢复统计量时多出来的一拍。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是 Normalizer 向 DUT 其他部分返回 mean 和 inverse standard deviation 的输出路径。
补丁把 load_stats 和 store_stats 的判定从 io.in.bits.acc_read_resp 切换到 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp，也就是实际被选中的输出上下文。
恢复的统计量不再经过 RegNext，因此去掉了读取已保存统计量时的一拍时序偏移。
evidence: Normalizer.scala 把 load_stats 条件从 io.in.bits.acc_read_resp.load_stats 改成了 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp.load_stats。
load 路径里的 stat_mem 索引也对应改成了 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp.stat_addr。
原来包裹 stat_mem_entry.mean 与 stat_mem_entry.inv_stddev 的 RegNext 被删除，同时 store_stats 条件也改为依赖 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当归一化引擎能够同时跟踪多个在途统计上下文时，读取或写回已保存统计量时必须使用正在退役的输出上下文元数据。如果它错误地改为读取当前输入请求，那么只要请求在时间上重叠，saved-stat RAM 就可能使用错误的上下文 ID 进行读写。若再给恢复的统计量额外增加一级寄存器，返回值相对于输出握手还会再错后一拍。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 退役阶段的 saved-stat 上下文选择
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 至少有一个统计上下文正在退役，而另一个请求正在进入，或者已经更新了当前输入元数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 saved-stat 的 load/store 控制依赖当前输入请求而不是被选中的输出上下文，并可选地给恢复输出再加一拍。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何支持多个未完成上下文、并带有保存统计量或校准状态小 RAM 的 reduction 或 normalization 模块。
可移植的关键点是必须使用“正在退役的上下文”元数据，而不是 Gemmini 特有的 out_stats_id 名称。
如果目标 DUT 也显式暴露恢复统计量的时序，那么额外一拍的部分同样值得复现。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位决定本周期哪个统计上下文正在退役的输出选择逻辑。
把 saved-stat RAM 的控制与索引改为使用最新输入请求的元数据，而不是退役上下文的元数据。
可选地在恢复的 mean 或 inverse-standard-deviation 输出上增加一级寄存器。
运行带有多个 context ID 的重叠 saved-stat load/store 序列。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Normalizer 中 stat_mem 的 load/store 输出选择
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 stat_mem 的 load_stats、store_stats 以及 stat_addr 都绑定到 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp，并去掉了恢复统计量输出上的 RegNext。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 stat_mem 的 load/store 逻辑里把 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp 改回 io.in.bits.acc_read_resp，并给恢复的 mean 和 inv_stddev 加回 RegNext。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 已保存统计量会从错误的上下文条目读取或写回，而且还可能晚一拍出现，导致之后的归一化参数错误。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁里的所有功能性变化都围绕“由谁驱动 saved-stat RAM”和“恢复值何时出现”这两个点展开。
新代码在 load 和 store 两条路径上一致地使用 stats(out_stats_id).req.acc_read_resp，说明原始 bug 是上下文来源混淆，而不是数据格式问题。
被删除的 RegNext 还说明恢复统计量确实存在一个真实的时序偏差，这一点也可以直接重新注入。
notes: 这个 bug 更容易在交错的 context ID 上暴露，而不是单一串行归一化流。
如果只做一种变异，首选错误的上下文选择；额外一拍属于可选的次要故障。
